.AVIATION...

Weak shortwave energy pushing into the Lake Superior basin is 
leading to large scale support for ascent and high cloud across 
Lower Michigan this evening. Forecast soundings strongly support 
residual stability winning out and keeping a very dry environmental 
profile between 2.5 and 8.0 kft agl. Period of midlevel fgen does 
push through between 09-14z but no precipitation expected. Flow 
trajectories become strongly anticylonic after 15z Tuesday causing 
downward vertical motion.  Northwest winds Tuesday afternoon 10 to 
20 knots.
